metadata.question: Does the surface water extent along the Lower Mississippi River (e.g., Arkansas City, Arkansas; Vicksburg, Mississippi; Natchez, Mississippi) increase in March 19, 2019 compared to March 19, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: Global Surface Water "JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory" – contains monthly water occurrence masks. - Date: March 2017 vs March 2019 (specifically the 19th); GSW is monthly composites, so exact day is fine (product holds monthly layer with date YYYY-MM-01). - Location: 30-km buffer along ~240-km Lower Mississippi River segment covering Arkansas City AR, Vicksburg MS, Natchez MS. I’ll build a single LineString of those three towns, then buffer 15 km to create a 30-km-wide polygon that captures the river and its flood-plain. 2. Masking strategy - GSW monthly layers already have a quality "water" mask (value 2 = water). No cloud masking needed – this is a derived surface-water product. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error - For each year (2017, 2019) pull the March image, keep only the "water" class (=2), convert to binary 0/1. - Calculate total water pixels (sum) and total valid pixels (count) inside the region. - If either year has 0 valid pixels → C2; if either image is missing → C1; if computed totals are None/NaN → C3. - Increase is true if 2019 water pixels > 2017; else false. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Cover the Lower-Mississippi segment: Arkansas City -> Vicksburg -> Natchez towns = [ [-91.2018, 33.6089], # Arkansas City, AR [-90.8759, 32.3527], # Vicksburg, MS [-91.2993, 31.5604] # Natchez, MS ] river_line = ee.Geometry.LineString(towns) roi = river_line.buffer(15000) # 30-km buffer # 2. Grab GSW monthly water masks for March 2017 and March 2019 start_17, end_17 = ee.Date('2017-03-19'), ee.Date('2017-03-20') start_19, end_19 = ee.Date('2019-03-19'), ee.Date('2019-03-20') col17 = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate(start_17, end_17)) col19 = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterDate(start_19, end_19)) if col17.size().getInfo() == 0 or col19.size().getInfo() == 0: print("C1: Empty Collection") print("C1") else: img17 = col17.first() img19 = col19.first() # Water pixels: waterClass = 2; convert to 0/1 water17 = img17.eq(2).selfMask() water19 = img19.eq(2).selfMask() # Valid pixels (mask presence) valid17 = img17.neq(0) valid19 = img19.neq(0) # reduce tot17 = (water17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('water').getInfo()) cnt17 = (valid17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('water').getInfo()) tot19 = (water19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('water').getInfo()) cnt19 = (valid19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('water').getInfo()) # Validation if tot17 is None or cnt17 is None or tot19 is None or cnt19 is None: print("C3: Calculation Failure") print("C3") elif cnt17 == 0 or cnt19 == 0: print("C2: No Valid Pixels") print("C2") else: print(f"2017 water pixels: {int(tot17)} (valid: {cnt17})") print(f"2019 water pixels: {int(tot19)} (valid: {cnt19})") if tot19 > tot17: print("A") else: print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Cover the Lower-Mississippi segment: Arkansas City -> Vicksburg -> Natchez
towns = [
    [-91.2018, 33.6089],   # Arkansas City, AR
    [-90.8759, 32.3527],   # Vicksburg, MS
    [-91.2993, 31.5604]    # Natchez, MS
]
river_line = ee.Geometry.LineString(towns)
roi = river_line.buffer(15000)  # 30-km buffer

# 2. Grab GSW monthly water masks for March 2017 and March 2019
start_17, end_17 = ee.Date('2017-03-19'), ee.Date('2017-03-20')
start_19, end_19 = ee.Date('2019-03-19'), ee.Date('2019-03-20')

col17 = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
           .filterDate(start_17, end_17))
col19 = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
           .filterDate(start_19, end_19))

if col17.size().getInfo() == 0 or col19.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("C1: Empty Collection")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img17 = col17.first()
    img19 = col19.first()

    # Water pixels: waterClass = 2; convert to 0/1
    water17 = img17.eq(2).selfMask()
    water19 = img19.eq(2).selfMask()

    # Valid pixels (mask presence)
    valid17 = img17.neq(0)
    valid19 = img19.neq(0)

    # reduce
    tot17 = (water17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                  geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                    .get('water').getInfo())
    cnt17 = (valid17.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                  geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                    .get('water').getInfo())

    tot19 = (water19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                                  geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                    .get('water').getInfo())
    cnt19 = (valid19.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                  geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9)
                    .get('water').getInfo())

    # Validation
    if tot17 is None or cnt17 is None or tot19 is None or cnt19 is None:
        print("C3: Calculation Failure")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif cnt17 == 0 or cnt19 == 0:
        print("C2: No Valid Pixels")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"2017 water pixels: {int(tot17)} (valid: {cnt17})")
        print(f"2019 water pixels: {int(tot19)} (valid: {cnt19})")
        if tot19 > tot17:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
